title: Mimas map
description: One map (maps/*.json). The catalogue also checks symmetry, spawn distance and connectivity at boot, which a schema cannot.

description.description: Authoring prose. Core parses it away: MapData has no Description, so nothing reads this yet.

symmetry.description: Only rotational-180 is implemented; mirror-q throws at build time.

ladderPosition.description: Where the map sits in the ladder of maps.

height.description: A rules value, not a visual one: walking climbs at most maxClimb, and tall tiles block sight.

effect.description: Modifier id this single hex grants to whoever stands on it.

prop.description: Id of a props/*.json body standing on this hex. The terrain must be walkable, the 180-degree twin must carry the same prop, and a spawn may carry none.
